# Mario Marcolongo — Research & Technical Operations

Mario Marcolongo works on scientific information quality, research operations and practical technical problems. His evidence includes paid science communication work, public source investigations and accepted open source contributions. Based in Italy, he is an Italian citizen studying IT through Metropolia Open UAS and developing independent Python, SQL and quantitative skills.
